messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Issue with Large data set in map function
parts:
Just to confirm
A) you're sure you want the inner lapply and seq_along on v[[I]]
B) if yes replace the v.1<- with v.1=1 and time it. The bytes2float might be costly

On Jun 8, 2013 5:40 AM, "Max" <er.bi...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi,

I am trying to run map reduce using custom input format. Data is reading from HBase.

When I am trying to calculate mean inside my map function, it is taking longer time compare to other operation like count.
The input format to map function is as <Row-key, list(column_values)>. One row have 230-270 column values. Each row-key is unique.

##############Map function to calculate mean #######################
map1 <- expression({
    r2t.init() ##initilization of r2time framework
    val <- lapply(seq_along(map.keys),function(i){
               v <- map.values[[i]]
               m.1 <- lapply(seq_along(v), function(i) { 
                                   v.1 <- r2t.bytes2float(v[[i]])  ####r2t.bytest2float is a function that convert byte array into float.
                } )
              m.5 <- mean(as.numeric(m.1))
             return (m.5)   
           })
         mean <- mean(as.numeric(val))
        rhcollect(1, mean)   
})
################################################################
There is no error. But it is taking longer time compare to other operation. It take almost 1hour 50 minute on 23 GB of data with 15 nodes.
Here just 2 more extra operation is going on.

#########Map function to calculate number of data point ############################
map1 <- expression({
    val <- lapply(seq_along(map.keys),function(i){
               v <- map.values[[i]]       
              count <- length(v)          
              return (count)   
         })
    count.1 <- length(as.numeric(val))
    rhcollect(1,  count.1)   
})
#############################################################################
This operation is much more faster. It take 2 minutes on 23 GB of data with 15 nodes.

Could anybody help me with this issue.

Thanks
Bikash
